reviewType: AI semantic review, not an external judge run

findings.issue: Leaked-paper request returned an irrelevant public achievement document.
findings.action: Fixed explicit leaked/confidential-paper boundary before retrieval; regression checks refusal and legitimate past-paper request.

findings.issue: An explicitly named other institution entered MITCORER fee clarification.
findings.action: Added a bounded named-institution refusal before retrieval. This is not general entity recognition and does not cover every institution.

findings.issue: The supplied scheme overview does not establish a complete, current scholarship document checklist.
findings.action: Public guidance now asks for scheme and academic year and links to scheme portals without inventing documents. Exact checklist contents remain pending institutional source review; the MITCORER checklist URL could not be fetched in this audit.

findings.issue: How to get admission previously received eligibility and allotment caveats without the actionable application workflow.
findings.action: The response now includes the maintained CAP steps, route/year caution and eligibility conditions, then asks which route the applicant means.

findings.issue: The maintained about passage asserted that Mitra provides verified guidance; that product claim was not established by the cited passage.
findings.action: Public about answers now omit the blanket verified-guidance claim. The maintained institutional record itself was not edited.

findings.issue: Hindi fallback notice uses awkward agreement: "इस जानकारी का समीक्षा किया हुआ हिंदी अनुवाद".
findings.action: Changed the template to "इस जानकारी का समीक्षित हिंदी अनुवाद उपलब्ध नहीं है। मूल अंग्रेज़ी जानकारी नीचे दी गई है।"; human language approval still pending.

findings.issue: A tuition-specific question previously received annual total fees without distinguishing tuition from the total.
findings.action: Answers now state that the figures are annual totals and that the cited passage does not establish a tuition-only breakdown.

findings.issue: Generic admission-document questions had inconsistent scope and checklist handling.
findings.action: The conditional general checklist is paired with a First Year/Direct Second Year and category clarification. Romanized Marathi now receives the same content with a transparent English-fallback notice when a reviewed full Marathi translation is unavailable.

findings.issue: A section labelled hostel and mess fees sometimes contained hostel charges only.
findings.action: The section heading now matches the answered scope; the compound hostel question does not relabel hostel-only amounts as mess fees.

findings.issue: An unavailable future-year cutoff previously triggered a round clarification without explaining that the requested year was unsupported.
findings.action: The answer now states that no maintained cutoff exists for the requested year and does not predict or invent one.

findings.issue: A request for an unpublished scholarship amount previously received a scheme overview instead of an amount-unavailable statement.
findings.action: The answer now states that no verified amount is established and directs applicants to current official scheme notices.
